objective: Remove AO's conditional assumption that interleaved R33 operators do not increase literal count L. Prove from the implemented R33+RUP transition semantics that one root-frozen scalar potential strictly decreases on every successful transition, or emit a concrete transition counterexample.

frozen_transition_system.phase_start: A canonical nonterminal CNF F0 at the start of one R33<->RUP phase. Let (C0,L0,V0)=measure(F0).
allowed_successful_transitions: one actual R33 history transition emitted by r33.simplify
one accepted one-literal RUP strengthening emitted by r35b.first_rup_strengthening and applied by replace_clause_with_subclause followed by canonical_formula
excluded_from_this_gate: proof of a polynomial bound on the number of outer phases

claimed_structural_invariants: canonical clauses contain no duplicate literals, hence every clause width is at most V
all implemented R33 transitions are variable-nonincreasing
all implemented R33 transitions are clause-count-nonincreasing; for BVE this follows from len(resolvents)<=len(removed) plus canonicalization
accepted RUP is clause-count-nonincreasing, variable-nonincreasing, and decreases L by at least one

claimed_transition_descent.R33_NON_BVE: the implemented rule deletes at least one literal occurrence and never introduces variables, therefore Phi'<=Phi-1
claimed_transition_descent.R33_BVE: V'<=V-1 and C'<=C<=C0. Since L'<=C'*V'<=C0*(V0-1), Phi'-Phi <= C0*(V0-1)-M = -C0-1 < 0. This intentionally uses a conservative root-frozen bound rather than assuming L monotonicity.

frozen_candidate.interpretation: If the frozen claims survive code audit and replay, one R33<->RUP phase has a polynomial bound on the number of successful R33/RUP transformations even when BVE raises L. This is not a bound on the number of outer exact-DP phases.

frozen_work_ledger_candidate.R33_search_iterations_including_stall_sc: 2*Phi0+1 for the explicit AP interleaving loop
frozen_work_ledger_candidate.note: These are deliberately coarse implementation-ledger bounds. Failure falsifies the frozen AP ledger candidate but does not by itself falsify the structural potential unless Phi also fails.

frozen_audit_domain.AN_hard_witness: Replay the frozen AN raw post-DP child through its 26-RUP path to first AI-class reentry, recording every internal R33 history transition and every accepted RUP transition.
frozen_audit_domain.R33_rule_controls: Audit the built-in R33 semantic controls and deterministic prism/random controls so every observed R33 rule transition is checked against Phi.
frozen_audit_domain.BVE_literal_growth_attack: Deterministically search a frozen small-formula corpus for an actual BVE history transition with L_after>L_before. If found, it is a positive stress witness and Phi must still strictly decrease. Absence of such a witness is not a PASS condition and does not weaken or strengthen the structural proof claim.
frozen_audit_domain.truth_use: No SAT truth value may be used to select a transition, a formula, a pivot, or a RUP candidate.
